decisions.setIdentity: 1998 Pinnacle flagship Baseball released February 1998. This is NOT separate 1998 Pinnacle Performers, Pinnacle Plus, Pinnacle Certified (never officially released), Pinnacle Mint, Inside, Epix promo, or Zenith. Confirmed no existing matching VCS product; 1998 Pinnacle Performers is a different existing product.
decisions.base: One 200-card base set (#1–200); Rookies #158–181; Field of Vision #182–187; Goin' Jake #188–197; Checklists #198–200. All names/numbers verified against independent BaseballCardPedia and CollectionCount. BCP #114 'Bob Higginson' normalized to CollectionCount 'Bobby Higginson' with source discrepancy explicitly gated.
decisions.rookies: BaseballCardPedia reports no notable true rookie cards; CC key rookie annotations represent a Rookie-themed subset, not automatically a formal RC. Do not stamp all rookie-themed cards true RC without validated independent true-rookie list.
decisions.backStats: One-third each of base #1–157 printed Full, Home, and Away stats backs; base set is considered complete with any version. Treat Home and Away as collectible 157-card variants, while standard base represents Full. No additional back variants for base #158–200.
decisions.museum: 100-card partial parallel PP1–PP100 with a dedicated physical numbering sequence and silver wave Dufex. Does not correspond numerically to a full 200-card base parallel. The separate 100-card Artist's Proof exactly parallels PP1–PP100 with gold concentric-circle Dufex and AP stamp.
decisions.packaging: Regular hobby and retail: 10 cards per pack, 18 packs per box, MSRP $2.99. Power Packs: 20 regular cards PLUS one 3.5x5 oversized Power Pack Jumbo per pack, 12 packs per box, MSRP $4.99. Uncut six Field of Vision giants are separate one-card retail $9.99 packs, not ordinary wax.
decisions.epix: Cross-brand Epix: only one brand-specific type per printed E1–E24 in 1998 Pinnacle — Game E1–6, Season E7–12, Moment E13–18, Play E19–24. Three foil colors (Orange 70%, Purple 20%, Emerald 10%) per each of these 24 printed numbers; do not include 1998 Score/Zenith/Pinnacle Certified-only types, unreleased Certified cards or All-Star Epix from Pinnacle Plus and Score R/T.
decisions.epixPressPlates: BCP and TCDB indicate 24 subject/design Epix 1/1 press plates in this flagship (each front/back CMYK), independent of the three foil color parallel checklists. Derived from Epix Orange only for subject/number/type identity, but plate is genuine physical source printing plate and not labeled Orange in actual design.
decisions.hitItHere: 10 red-foil inserts each individually serial numbered, but manufacturer print run is not disclosed. The Opening Day 1998 hit-for-cycle million-dollar contest had no winner. Do not invent a /20000 cap. Gold version is documented only for Ken Griffey Jr. #2 (serial #02680) which surfaced 2018; the other 9 gold versions are speculative, not included.
decisions.spellbound: 50 individual letter pieces, each numbered #1–50. Same-player repeated letters are distinct physical cards and must not be deduplicated.
decisions.plates: 200 base + 24 Epix design + 10 Hit It Here + 50 Spellbound = 284 unique parent designs. Eight physical press plates each (front/back × CMYK) = 2,272 one-of-one cards, actually inserted in THIS 1998 Pinnacle product, combined 1:1250 hobby/retail/Power Pack according to manufacturer. Unlike 1997, these are PACK-inserted, not case-only bonus plates. Overall odds apply across the entire plate family, not per product set.
decisions.uncut: Six oversized Field of Vision jumbo Dufex photos #182–187; collector group distinct from 24 jumbo Power Packs and not regular pack hits. Dealer promo giant Frank Thomas excluded.
decisions.odds: Historical standard/Power odds: Museum 1:9/1:3, Artist's Proof 1:39/1:17, Epix any color 1:21/1:9, Hit It Here 1:19/1:9 (TCDB notes 1:17 hobby), Spellbound 1:17/1:7, Power Pack Jumbo N/A/one per pack, all press plates combined 1:1250. TCDB and BCP disagree on some Hit It Here hobby ratios; recorded both, do not select invented blended frequency. All product set oddsPerPack NULL until VCS can enforce format and group-wide plate pulls safely.
decisions.imageFactory: Use authentic scan templates for player-era photos, holographic nameplates, 1998 Dufex textures, letter cutouts, contest serials and true 1/1 press plates. No imagined designs. Set remains unreleased awaiting scans, pricing and collation review.
decisions.safety: Product released false; no added product can enter wax shop until Admin release. No changes to existing product pricing, collection records, images, pack art.

productSets.name: Base Set — Full Stats
productSets.notes: 200-card original issued set; #1–157 included in equal quantities with Full, Home and Away printed stat-backs. This 'Full Stats' group represents the original standard back and unified collector checklist.

productSets.name: Home Stats
productSets.notes: One third of original first 157 base cards. 'HOME STATS' printed on back.
productSets.derivedVariant: Original 1998 Pinnacle Home Stats back, #1–157 only; full career totals replaced with home totals, equal to Full and Away print share

productSets.name: Away Stats
productSets.notes: One third of original first 157 base cards. 'AWAY STATS' printed on back.
productSets.derivedVariant: Original 1998 Pinnacle Away Stats back, #1–157 only; full career totals replaced with away totals, equal to Full and Home print share

productSets.name: Museum Collection
productSets.notes: Authentic PP1–PP100 partial Museum parallel Dufex wave, 1:9 hobby/retail 1:3 Power Pack; printed numbering is PPn, not base card number.

productSets.name: Artist's Proof
productSets.notes: 100-card Artist's Proof follows Museum PP1–100 checklist with gold concentric Dufex and Artist's Proof stamp. 1:39 hobby/retail, 1:17 Power Pack.
productSets.derivedVariant: Authentic Artist's Proof gold concentric-circle Dufex and red Artist Proof stamp; numbered PP1–PP100, not full 200-card base

productSets.name: Power Pack Jumbos
productSets.notes: 24 separate numbered 3.5 x 5 inch cards, one in each special 20-card Power Pack; not ordinary wax.

productSets.name: Uncut Giant Cards
productSets.notes: Oversized 13 5/16 x 18 11/16 inch Dufex cards of base #182–187, distinct retail one-card package MSRP $9.99; not standard wax.

productSets.name: Epix Orange
productSets.notes: 24 Pinnacle-brand-specific E1–E24 subject/type checklists only, Orange foil 70% share. Any-color Epix 1:21 standard wax, 1:9 Power Pack.

productSets.name: Epix Purple
productSets.notes: Purple foil, 20% share of Epix production, exactly the same 24 Pinnacle-specific Game/Season/Moment/Play identities as Epix Orange.
productSets.derivedVariant: Pinnacle-specific 1998 Epix Purple foil, 20 percent print-color share, same E1–E24 types as Orange

productSets.name: Epix Emerald
productSets.notes: Emerald foil, 10% rare color share of same 24 Pinnacle-specific identities.
productSets.derivedVariant: Pinnacle-specific 1998 Epix Emerald foil, 10 percent print-color share, same E1–E24 types as Orange

productSets.name: Hit It Here
productSets.notes: Red etched-foil numbered 1–10, uniquely serial numbered for unrealized 1998 Opening Day million-dollar contest; total print quantity undisclosed.

productSets.name: Hit It Here — Gold (Verified)
productSets.notes: Exactly one confirmed gold-foil example: #2 Ken Griffey Jr., serial #02680 emerged in 2018. Other nine unverified cards excluded; unknown release channel or odds.

productSets.name: Spellbound
productSets.notes: Silver etched foil word-assembly 1–50; every letter is a separately numbered authentic collectible. 1:17 hobby wax, 1:7 Power Pack.

productSets.name: Press Plate — BASE front cyan
productSets.notes: Genuine one-of-one cyan front printing press plate for original base source card. All 32 plate groups distributed in physical 1998 Pinnacle wax/Power Packs at an overall 1:1250; never treat each group as 1:1250. Epix plates exist for 24 Pinnacle-specific E1–E24 designs, not separate plates for each color of the same design.
productSets.derivedVariant: 1998 Pinnacle authentic printing plate, one of one, base front cyan; manufacturer's physical printing plate with authentication seal; overall press-plate odds 1:1250 for all groups combined
